title: Ciao Manhattan
writer: John Palmer, David Weisman, Chuck Wein
actors: Edie Sedgwick, Wesley Hayes, Isabel Jewell
plot: This parallels the life of Andy Warhol Factory star Edie Sedgwick. The film chronicles "Susan Superstar's" (Sedgwick) glory days in the late 1960s through her inevitable downfall and the tragic addiction that would claim her life ...
